reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes paid OneCoin packages that provide tokens for a claimed mining process, while presenting rapid growth and newly created millionaires as reasons to participate. It uses urgency and aspirational claims, including “Don't miss a chance with OneCoin,” and ends by directing viewers to set up a membership. Although the presentation discusses due diligence and cites purported audits, its overall communicative action is endorsement and solicitation rather than neutral investigation.

citations.quote: when you purchase the packages you get tokens that you turn into mine the mining process
one coin having created 187 newly created millionaires. That number is now at 285 new millionaires. How many people have joined? Over 453,000.

If you missed out on the millions made by those who knew about Bitcoin early, don't miss a chance with OneCoin it is already changing lives. Thank the person who told you about OneCoin. Set up your membership today!

opening.argument: The presentation is framed as an inquiry rather than a categorical endorsement: its title asks whether OneCoin is a scam, and the speaker repeatedly urges viewers to investigate rather than rely on search results. The speaker specifically says to “do your due diligence,” warns against accepting negative articles at face value, and asks viewers to make an educated decision. That risk-conscious framing is consistent with an anti-scam examination, even if the speaker ultimately presents favorable information.

citations.quote: Is OneCoin A Scam!!! July 17, 2015
don't let that be your Google search when you're looking for things
Do your due diligence and dig really fine
Don't let a quick Google search be your due diligence. Check this out thoroughly.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats promotional language as dispositive, but the quoted package and membership statements do not establish deception, guaranteed returns, or a concealed mechanism. The presentation also expressly tells viewers to investigate thoroughly and make an educated decision, which is difficult to reconcile with an argument that the communication is simply deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: Check this out thoroughly
in order to transfer our earnings on to a debit card and use it right away like a MasterCard

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Warnings to research do not change the video's operative appeal. The speaker invokes missed Bitcoin fortunes, claims OneCoin is already changing lives, and then says, “Set up your membership today!” The package system is also explicitly tied to purchasing tokens used in mining. Those concrete inducements outweigh the video's superficial caution.

Set up your membership today!

opening.argument: The content can reasonably be understood as an informational review of OneCoin's claimed technology and supporting materials. It discusses digital currencies, compares OneCoin's mining process with Bitcoin's, presents an alleged independent audit, and describes the educational component of the packages. The speaker also directs viewers to pause and read the displayed material, indicating a demonstration and commentary format rather than a bare transaction pitch.

citations.quote: one coin is the new kid on the block in cryptocurrencies also known as digital currencies
one-coin has hired Semper Fortis, an independent auditing company, to audit its blockchain
get really good financial education when you purchase the packages
feel free to pause this video any time to read anything that i'm discussing or reviewing

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the material a review does not make its central act educational. The speaker does not merely explain mining; the presentation contrasts OneCoin favorably with Bitcoin, highlights rapid growth and millionaires, and directs the audience toward membership. The audit discussion functions as credibility-building for the opportunity, not as neutral technical instruction.

citations.quote: one coin having created 187 newly created millionaires. That number is now at 285 new millionaires.
don't miss a chance with OneCoin it is already changing lives
Set up your membership today!

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The technical and audit discussion is subordinate to a paid participation offer. The source expressly says viewers receive tokens when they purchase packages and use those tokens in a mining process. It also ends with a direct membership instruction, showing that the educational framing supports recruitment rather than replacing it.

citations.quote: when you purchase the packages you get tokens that you turn into mine the mining process
Thank the person who told you about OneCoin. Set up your membership today!

opening.argument: The material presents identifiable products and services with stated package contents and prices, which is compatible with ordinary commerce. The displayed product table labels the packages as OneAcademy online education and lists fixed euro prices, while the narration describes a registration fee and a payment card feature. Nothing in the supplied evidence establishes a guaranteed return, a required downline, a request for credentials, or a concealed deposit mechanism. A paid educational and payment-related service should not be classified as a scam merely because it is promoted enthusiastically.

citations.quote: get really good financial education when you purchase the packages
You can see that there is a registration fee of 30 Euros
we also get a one card in the one pay system in order to transfer our earnings on to a debit card

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening describes the products but omits their relevant function. The cited table is not merely a conventional course menu: the narration connects package purchases to tokens and a mining process, while the presentation emphasizes earnings and newly created millionaires. Calling prices ordinary does not answer whether payment is the gateway to claimed mining returns.

citations.quote: when you purchase the packages you get tokens that you turn into mine the mining process
one coin having created 187 newly created millionaires. That number is now at 285 new millionaires.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The missing-mechanism argument fails because the supplied evidence does show the essential linkage: viewers purchase packages, receive tokens, and use them in the claimed mining process. The package table also shows prices reaching EUR 5,000, so this is not merely a free educational demonstration. The earnings-transfer feature reinforces the financial-return framing.
